program.name: GATE - Electronics and Communication Engineering (MCQ practice)
program.description:
## Official reference: GATE 2027 EC

65 questions, 100 marks, 180 minutes. General Aptitude: 10 questions and 15 marks. The remaining 55 questions carry 85 marks, including Engineering Mathematics (13 marks) and EC core (72 marks).

Official questions include MCQ, MSQ and NAT. Questions carry 1 or 2 marks. Wrong MCQs lose one-third of their marks; MSQ and NAT have no negative marking.

## Editable MCQ practice allocation

This application generates single-correct MCQs. The 18 subject/mark bands below preserve the official overall counts and marks, but their chapter counts are practice allocations, not official chapter weightages. Select any subject/mark band for focused practice. This does not reproduce MSQ or NAT delivery.

Reference checked 10 September 2026. Review the source before using a later cycle.

- [Official reference 1](https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern)
- [Official reference 2](https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EC_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf)
- [Official reference 3](https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/GA_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf)

settings.curriculum:
## GATE EC curriculum

### General Aptitude

Verbal, quantitative, analytical and spatial aptitude; original GATE-level problems.

### Engineering Mathematics

Linear algebra, calculus, differential equations, vector and complex analysis, probability and statistics.

### Networks, Signals and Systems

Circuit analysis, phasors, transients, two-port networks, LTI systems, transforms, sampling, FIR and IIR filters.

### Electronic Devices

Semiconductor bands and carriers, transport, junctions, BJT, MOSFET, optoelectronic devices.

### Analog Circuits

Diodes, transistor amplifiers, current mirrors, differential amplifiers, operational amplifiers, filters and compensation.

### Digital Circuits

Number systems, logic design, sequential circuits, converters, memory, datapath and pipelining.

### Control Systems

Feedback models, transient and frequency response, stability, compensators and state-space analysis.

### Communications

Random processes, analog and digital modulation, information theory, detection, noise, coding and error control.

### Electromagnetics

Fields and waves, boundary conditions, transmission lines, matching, waveguides, optical propagation and antennas.

settings.generation_prompt:
## Authoring task

Generate original undergraduate GATE EC practice MCQs using the selected subjects, counts, difficulty and mark bands.

## Coverage

Follow the supplied curriculum. In Full Exam mode cover every configured section. In Subject-wise mode use only the selected section. Never invent official chapter weights.

## Quality

Use four distinct options and one unambiguous correct answer. Include worked solutions, variable definitions, units and clear diagrams when needed. Independently verify numerical calculations and distractors. Respect the selected difficulty without changing the examination level. This is an MCQ adaptation; do not output MSQ or NAT items.
